user.title: DEFCON Home sources
user.description: Configure immediate Home Assistant sources and the optional private GitHub context feed.

data_description.dwd_entities: Current and advance DWD warning-level sensors.
data_description.context_enabled: Poll the private contextual DEFCON JSON and merge it with local alerts.
data_description.github_repo: Private repository containing the feed. Default: defcon-json.
data_description.github_path: Path to the current feed. Default: status/current.json.
data_description.github_token: Fine-grained GitHub token with Contents: Read only on the private feed repository.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one DEFCON Home instance can be configured.

init.title: DEFCON Home options
init.description: Changes are applied immediately. The GitHub token stays in Home Assistant config storage and is never exposed as a sensor attribute.

data_description.github_token: Use a dedicated fine-grained token restricted to Contents: Read on defcon-json.
